mutants.name: subtractives-missing
mutants.replacement: export function roman(n){if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<1||n>3999)throw new RangeError('roman');let out='';for(const [v,s]of [[1000,'M'],[500,'D'],[400,'CD'],[100,'C'],[90,'XC'],[50,'L'],[40,'XL'],[10,'X'],[9,'IX'],[5,'V'],[1,'I']])while(n>=v){out+=s;n-=v;}return out;}
